desc:
An exploration of infinite sums, from convergent to divergent, including a brief introduction to the 2-adic metric, all themed on that cycle between discovery and invention in math.

recs.x: I loved this video [link] "An exploration of infinite sums, from convergent to divergent, including a brief introduction to the 2-adic metric, all themed on that cycle between discovery and invention in math."

With this context in mind, there have been some cool efforts to mix the second and third channels I just mentioned to communicate advanced math concepts. Vi Hart and Grant Sanderson's [link] channels come to mind. Here are my favorite videos by Grant:

- "What does it feel like to invent math": [link]

recs.stt: Mathematicians Find Long-Sought Building Blocks for Special Polynomials
recs.x: You add infinite number of positives numbers to each other and you get -1 as a result. p-adic numbers are adding some sense to this seemingly contradictory result. Great intro: [link]
